requirements.quote:
To enable
the user to request a particular type of information, an appropriate
query type is passed to the resolver with the domain name.
requirements.condition: When a user requests a particular type of information for a domain name
requirements.required_behavior: Pass the appropriate query type to the resolver together with the domain name.
requirements.why_checkable: The resolver request interface can be checked for the domain name and information-selecting query type.

requirements.quote:
To the user,
the domain tree is a single information space; the resolver is
responsible for hiding the distribution of data among name servers from
the user.
requirements.condition: When resolving domain information distributed among name servers
requirements.required_behavior: Handle the distribution of data within the resolver so the user can use the domain tree as a single information space.
requirements.why_checkable: A lookup spanning different name servers can check whether the resolver handles server selection without requiring the user to navigate the distribution.

requirements.quote:
The
resolver starts with knowledge of at least one name server.
requirements.required_behavior: Have knowledge of at least one name server.
requirements.why_checkable: Initial resolver configuration or bootstrap state can be checked for a known name server.

requirements.quote:
When the
resolver processes a user query it asks a known name server for the
information; in return, the resolver either receives the desired
information or a referral to another name server.
requirements.condition: When processing a user query through the name-server lookup flow described here
requirements.required_behavior: Ask a known name server for the requested information.
requirements.why_checkable: The destination of the resolver lookup can be compared with its known name-server state.

requirements.quote:
Using these
referrals, resolvers learn the identities and contents of other name
servers.
requirements.condition: When a resolver receives referrals to other name servers
requirements.required_behavior: Use the referrals to learn the identities of other name servers.
requirements.why_checkable: Referral processing can be checked for discovery of the referred name-server identities.

requirements.quote:
Using these
referrals, resolvers learn the identities and contents of other name
servers.
requirements.condition: When a resolver receives referrals to other name servers
requirements.required_behavior: Use the referrals to learn the contents available from other name servers.
requirements.why_checkable: Referral-directed resolution can be checked for obtaining information from the referred name servers.

requirements.quote:
Resolvers are responsible for dealing with the distribution of
the domain space and dealing with the effects of name server failure by
consulting redundant databases in other servers.
requirements.required_behavior: Consult redundant databases in other servers to deal with the failure.
requirements.why_checkable: Resolver failover can be checked by making a selected server fail while another server holds redundant data.

requirements.quote:
each zone is the complete database for a particular
"pruned" subtree of the domain space.
requirements.condition: For data held as a zone
requirements.required_behavior: Represent the complete database for the particular pruned subtree of the domain space.
requirements.why_checkable: The zone data model and loaded records can be compared with the records belonging to its pruned subtree.

requirements.quote:
Name servers manage two kinds of data.  The first kind of data held in
sets called zones; each zone is the complete database for a particular
"pruned" subtree of the domain space.  This data is called
authoritative.
requirements.condition: For the zone data held by a name server
requirements.required_behavior: Treat the zone data as authoritative data.
requirements.why_checkable: The server can be inspected for the authoritative classification of its zone data.

requirements.quote:
A name server periodically checks to make sure that its
zones are up to date, and if not, obtains a new copy of updated zones
requirements.condition: While a name server maintains its zones
requirements.required_behavior: Periodically check whether the zones are up to date.
requirements.why_checkable: Zone-maintenance scheduling can be inspected for recurring currency checks without imposing an interval absent from this passage.

requirements.quote:
A name server periodically checks to make sure that its
zones are up to date, and if not, obtains a new copy of updated zones
requirements.condition: When a name server determines that a zone is not up to date
requirements.required_behavior: Obtain a new copy of the updated zone.
requirements.why_checkable: An outdated-zone maintenance path can be checked for obtaining a replacement copy.

requirements.quote:
The second
kind of data is cached data which was acquired by a local resolver.
This data may be incomplete,
requirements.condition: For cached data acquired by a local resolver
requirements.required_behavior: Permit the cached data to be incomplete.
requirements.why_checkable: The cache data model can be checked for supporting partial data without requiring a complete zone.

requirements.quote:
Cached
data is eventually discarded by a timeout mechanism.
requirements.required_behavior: Eventually discard the cached data through a timeout mechanism.
requirements.why_checkable: Cache lifetime handling can be checked for timeout-based removal without assuming a duration not stated here.
